description: This file contains shell script code for performance testing of sorting algorithms and related utilities. It defines tests that measure the performance of 'sort', custom string list sorting, and mergesort implementations, using a prepared set of files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, taking a description and a command block.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Measures the performance of a specified command or operation.

methods.name: test_cmp_bin
methods.description: Compares binary files to verify sorting correctness.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
